_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.2.81: Simulator queues with complete trial recordings.

The Simulator tab verifies the ProSim 8 mini-USB DEVICE connection, previews large
BP/heart-rate/volume/envelope-shift queues, and runs the selected product preset
once per trial. Defaults are 120/80 mmHg, 72 bpm, 1 mL. MAP is calculated. Adult
and Neonatal waves require confirmation on the ProSim screen. Cuff, mandrel and
notes accompany dated setting-specific Arduino, native NI and ProSim files.
Each trial is followed by a verified vented 30-second break. Existing Bench tools
remain available. STOP and recording/link failures retain partial data and stop
the queue. Native NI time remains the reference; calibration history is retained.

Validation: 1,269 source tests passed (5 skipped); all 13 offline gates passed.
The packaged GUI opened with its bundled Python without exceptions. Valinor's
Max 80-220 menu and firmware rev27v-gauge-38 control profile are unchanged.
The shared ProSim command order measured about 72 bpm for a 72 bpm request in
two Default Arm CVP trials. This is a limited integration check, not qualification
of every simulator setting or the Valinor pressure range.
